rendererDepthRangeMetres.rationale: match the frozen metric-depth range used throughout the U3 dense CPU reconstruction path

metricConventions.p95: nearest-rank over sorted finite values with ties resolved to the lower index, identical to U3c nearest_tie_lower
metricConventions.sceneAggregation: arithmetic mean of each per-target-view scalar over the eight frozen target views

descriptiveComparison.pairedSceneBootstrap: 2000 replicates with Python random.Random(42), median of five scene differences, nearest-tie-lower 2.5/97.5 percentiles
